generation_strategy: One independent request per asset, all three requests in one parallel batch; no variants or retries.
reference_role: Style references inspected visually before generation; supplied images were not edit targets.
alpha_notes: Original generated RGBA bytes preserved unchanged. Each file has alpha extrema 0-254 and true fully transparent pixels. RGB beneath transparent pixels contains dark gradients; raw image viewers may show that RGB instead of compositing alpha. Gate has a larger population of low-alpha background pixels; check compositing on the site's cream background. No checkerboard background was generated and no cleanup was performed.

assets.name: storybook-stage
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: standalone raster cutout for a playful adult wedding storybook website, not a webpage mockup.
Primary request: a wide open antique pop-up book with ivory and warm cream paper pages, a few small folded paper garden hills near the rear and outer sides, and a dusty maroon ribbon bookmark. The broad central spread must stay clear and unobstructed so existing couple and garden-gate artwork can be layered over it.
Style/medium: adult hand-inked storybook illustration with precise angular ink contours, subtle scratchy pencil hatching, layered paper-cutout planes and warm parchment grain; stylish and romantic, slightly eccentric rather than childish.
Composition/framing: wide landscape, complete book visible with generous clear margin, front view slightly from above; an open book presented as one isolated stage object. Folded details remain low and sparse. No characters and no gate within this asset.
Lighting/mood: light, airy, whimsical daylight; welcoming and romantic.
Color palette: ivory, cream, warm parchment and restrained dusty maroon. Dark brown fine ink outlines only, minimal solid black.
Background/output: genuine fully transparent PNG alpha background around the object, including negative spaces; preserve clean natural edges. No visible checkerboard pattern, no white canvas, no scene background, no floor, no cast shadow outside the cutout.
Constraints: no lettering, no words, no numerals, no logos, no watermark; no horror imagery, no skulls, no candles, no faces, no heavy dark masses.

assets.name: storybook-gate
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: standalone portrait raster cutout for an interactive playful adult wedding storybook website.
Primary request: a whimsical airy tall double garden gate under a lightly curling rose arch. Use cream-painted thin wrought iron with dusty maroon accents and sparse pale cream and maroon roses. The gate is clearly CLOSED: two equally sized symmetric leaves meet exactly at the vertical center, with a clean seam so the two halves can be animated separately. The thin ironwork remains open and airy.
Style/medium: adult hand-inked storybook illustration with crisp slightly angular ink contours, restrained scratchy hatching, layered paper-cutout feeling, warm paper texture, elegant ornamental curls.
Composition/framing: centered straight-on full front elevation; complete arch, posts and both symmetric closed gate leaves visible; tall portrait silhouette with clear margins; strong readable shape. Transparent negative space through all ironwork.
Lighting/mood: romantic bright daytime, whimsical and welcoming.
Color palette: predominantly ivory/cream painted iron, warm parchment edge shading, subtle dusty maroon flourishes and sparse roses. Fine dark-brown outlines, very little solid black.
Background/output: genuine fully transparent PNG alpha background around and THROUGH the gate ironwork; preserve the generated alpha. No checkerboard pattern, no white canvas, no opaque backdrop, no ground or external shadow.
Constraints: one gate only; no people, no characters, no book, no buildings, no scenery, no text, no lettering, no watermark; no heavy black iron, no horror, no thorns dominating the silhouette.

assets.name: raven-messenger
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: isolated raster cutout for a playful adult wedding storybook website.
Primary request: a charming elegant raven flying with its wings gracefully spread, carrying a sealed cream invitation envelope tied with a dusty maroon ribbon. Make the beak clearly hold the ribbon so the envelope hangs naturally beneath. A plain maroon wax seal with no lettering.
Style/medium: adult hand-inked angular storybook illustration; expressive precise ink contours, elongated elegant feather shapes, subtle scratchy hatching and paper-cutout planes, lightly worn parchment texture. Whimsical sophisticated companion to an ink-drawn wedding couple.
Composition/framing: landscape-ish balanced flying silhouette, full raven and full invitation visible with clear margins; the envelope is legible as an object; wings and ribbon arranged to avoid covering the envelope.
Lighting/mood: friendly, romantic, playful daylight; elegant curiosity, no menace.
Color palette: raven charcoal and warm brown-black with cream feather highlights, ivory envelope, dusty maroon ribbon and seal; avoid large featureless black areas.
Background/output: genuine fully transparent PNG alpha background around the entire bird, ribbon and envelope and in all gaps; preserve clean edges and alpha. No checkerboard pattern, no white canvas, no scenery or external cast shadow.
Constraints: no human characters, no text, no writing, no logos, no watermark, no horror, no skulls, no extra birds or objects.
